title: Convert into a lab book
offer: Give this book its own lab book storage. Its records, history, originals, datasets, figures, links and sharing state move with it.
explain: First every record is copied and verified while this book stays current; records can be read but not edited meanwhile. Only when all are verified is each record moved into the lab book. You can close Observanda and resume later, or return everything to this book until the conversion finishes.

phase_verified: All records verified. Moving them into the lab book: {moved} of {records} moved.
phase_switched: Converted. The book now has its own lab book.
phase_returned: All records are back in this book.
